body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Paris, France. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 10 km. It starts at La Cinémathèque Française, 51 Rue de Bercy, 75012 Paris, France. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to La Cinémathèque Française. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone. WeGoTrip names Kseniya as the tour's author.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Discover the interplay between history and innovation with this Self-Guided Audio Tour through Paris. The tour includes a ticket to La Cinémathèque Française's Jean-Paul Belmondo Exhibition. Please note that an audio tour inside La Cinémathèque Française is not provided within this bundle.
>
> After your visit to La Cinémathèque Française, this audio guide will lead you on a path through the architectural marvels and historical heartbeats of Paris, concluding at the ancient Obelisk of Luxor.
>
> The route will take you over the Seine on the sleek Pont Charles de Gaulle, through the stories of the Pont d'Austerlitz, and around the literary oasis of Shakespeare and Company. You'll witness Notre-Dame's grandeur, rest by the serene Fontaine de la Vierge, and contemplate Paris's turbulent history at the Conciergerie. As you walk, you'll admire the lofty Tour Saint-Jacques, the art encased within the grand Louvre Museum, and the striking Louvre Pyramid.
>
> Highlights along the way include absorbing tales of cinematic pioneers, marveling at the intersection of historic celebrations in the square's fountains, and standing beneath the timeless hieroglyphs. This tour promises a deep connective experience between the listener and Paris's tangible history, enduring art, and the visionary evolution presented through its landmarks.
